acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of water heater repair in Goodyear can vary significantly depending on the specific issue and the parts required. Minor repairs, such as replacing a thermostat or heating element, might range from $150 to $400. More complex problems, like a significant leak or a damaged tank, could be more expensive and sometimes lead to recommending a full replacement.
